reception: Outside those two lines the citation record is thin. A few external works cite the paper briefly: a systematic literature review of DSLs for algorithmic graph processing includes it, eCC++ names it as an instance of compiler construction for embedded DSLs, and Flan's Datalog compiler mentions it in passing among staging-based systems. None engages the staging argument in depth; the case the paper makes is carried mainly by the group's own successor systems rather than by external uptake. An archival artifact accompanies the paper.
